EQUILIBRIUM uses generative AI to power its core gameplay mechanic: the Policy Terminal.
LIVE-GENERATED CONTENT
When a player types a directive or law in natural language (e.g., "Abolish the luxury car tax"), the AI Engine analyzes the request in real time and generates a structured governmental dossier, including:
- Legislative feasibility analysis
- Budget impact and financial coverage
- Macroeconomic effects (GDP, debt, inflation)
- Social and political consensus projections
- Parliamentary vote simulation
Model used: Anthropic Claude, accessed via API.
Guardrails: AI output is constrained to a fixed set of structured fields defined by the developer. All numeric effects are clamped within bounds enforced by the simulation engine, so no AI output can produce values outside the game's defined ranges. The model operates only on the simulation state provided to it and cannot invent game data: commands that cannot be mapped to a valid government action are refused, and the player is offered bounded policy alternatives instead. No image, audio, or user-data generation is involved, and no player data is used to train any model.
Because responses are generated at runtime, outputs vary between playthroughs: the same directive may produce different wording and different outcomes.
PRE-GENERATED CONTENT

FACEMINER is a concept-driven game that directly engages with the ethics of AI. For thematic purposes, the game features faces which have been generated by a GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) trained on the FFHQ dataset, a research dataset released by NVIDIA that is the backbone of many real-world facial recognition applications. Per NVIDIA, only images under permissive licenses were collected.
The 'AI training' in this game is fictional and has been simulated for entertainment purposes. The game can be interpreted as a critique of AI specifically relating to the ecological impact of mass data hoarding, surveillance concerns, and way it is used to compound corporate power.

In "Stay Alive My Son," artificial intelligence (AI) plays a crucial role at two distinct points in the game to enhance player immersion and emotional engagement. Specifically, AI is employed during an interaction with Yathay Pin's digital replica in Level 01 and once again in Level 06. This is programmed directly using existing Unreal Engine Blueprints nodes.
The AI integration is meticulously designed to enable Yathay's digital eyes to follow the player's movements continuously. This technology ensures that Yathay appears to be directly engaging with the player, fostering a deeper emotional connection. The purpose behind this AI application is to intensify the sense of direct communication and interaction with Yathay, thereby amplifying the player's emotional investment and empathy towards his journey and experiences.

Dead Reckoning is written, and designed by one person. I want to be precise about where AI tools do and don't appear in it.
Creative content — no generative AI. All writing, narrative, and design is mine. I've worked as a technical writer for twelve years; the game's voice is my own. All art and visual assets are hand-made or licensed from named human artists. All music and sound effects are licensed from named human creators (public domain / Creative Commons) — none of it is AI-generated. This is a hard line and I intend to keep it.
Development & release tooling — where AI assists. I use AI in the engineering and release pipeline only, never to author the game itself:
- Coding assistance while writing the game's GDScript.
- An automated QA/test harness that plays the simulation thousands of times to catch crashes and balance regressions.
- Assistance in building linters (Valve YAML sheets) that check the project's  text.
- Drafting and summarizing the release notes (patch notes) from the project's changelog.
None of this creates any of the writing, art, audio, or design inside the game.
Localization. The four translations (German, French, Italian, Spanish) are machine-translated by DeepL from my English source, with automated guards that fall back to English wherever a translation would break. This is an accessibility vs. quality decision, and I decided on the former. Proper localizations are planned and will be contracted out if the budget allows.

Neverending AI Storybook brings your imagination to life with cutting-edge AI that crafts personalized stories and stunning illustrations, all based on your choices. Each adventure is one-of-a-kind—just select your setting, characters, and themes, and let the AI weave a completely unique tale for you.
Every page brings fresh, AI-generated content— story pages, illustrations, and multiple choices—to guide your journey. No two playthroughs are alike, and the AI adapts to your decisions, making each story an evolving experience shaped by your creativity.
What makes it special? It’s all available offline—100% private and secure. Your stories, choices, and inputs can stay local on your device, with no data sent anywhere—not even to us. just you and the AI, creating endless adventures in complete privacy. The way it should be. There is also an option for online cloud based generation using the Google Gemini Service (API Key Required, internet required, not private) but it is entirely optional and designed so that users with slower hardware can enjoy the game too.
Whether you're exploring a whimsical fantasy or unraveling a thrilling mystery, your stories are yours alone. Enjoy a personalized, secure storytelling experience that puts your imagination at the forefront—without compromise.

Our game utilizes Generative Artificial Intelligence for the creation of visual content. Pre-created images were initially generated by the system, undergoing minor modifications before the game's launch. This approach allows us to offer a unique and immersive experience, enriching the game's universe with dynamic visual elements. It's important to note that these modifications do not occur during actual gameplay, ensuring consistency in the experience for all players. The careful implementation of AI guarantees the quality and integrity of the content, aligning with Steam Store guidelines and providing players with a captivating journey.

The development of Eldara incorporated AI-generated content. Specifically, AI image generation tools were used to create certain in-game visual assets, including monster portraits, pet illustrations, item icons, and character artwork.
All AI-generated assets were manually reviewed, curated, and integrated by the developer before inclusion in the final product. No real-world copyrighted artwork was intentionally used as input to the AI generation process.

Generative AI was carefully used for structuring the majority of content available in the decks, given the vast breadth of the topics/languages available. However, every piece of information was extracted from publicly available curated sources, where AI was used for the re-writing the facts into questions. Also, in general the distractors (wrong answers) are intelligently chosen at runtime based on similar answers of similar length, however it can occur that certain answer pools where too small for reasonable gameplay. For this, fake answers were generated by AI as well, albeit rarely.
